args:
set -eu
PGPASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h $PGHOST -U $PGUSER -d $PGDATABASE -Atc "
  select 'hidden_entity_candidates=' || count(*)
  from working.entity_candidate
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and candidate_payload::text ~* '(hidden|evaluator|truth)';

  select 'hidden_fact_candidates=' || count(*)
  from working.fact_candidate
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and fact_value::text ~* '(hidden|evaluator|truth)';

  select 'hidden_relationship_candidates=' || count(*)
  from working.relationship_candidate
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and array_to_string(evidence_refs, ',') ~* '(hidden|evaluator|truth)';

  select concat_ws('|',
    'entity',
    candidate_ref,
    source_version_ref,
    display_name,
    left(candidate_payload::text, 450)
  )
  from working.entity_candidate
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and candidate_payload::text ~* '(hidden|evaluator|truth)'
  limit 12;

  select concat_ws('|',
    'fact',
    candidate_ref,
    source_version_ref,
    fact_type,
    left(fact_value::text, 450)
  )
  from working.fact_candidate
  where tenant_key='airline-demo-new' and fact_value::text ~* '(hidden|evaluator|truth)'
  limit 12;
"
containers.name: airdn-job
